Electronics — from inflated numbers to real growth

A mobile phones and accessories store. The dashboards looked great, but the real return didn't match. I found why, fixed it, and then scaled.

  1. The problem

    The store ran on EasyOrders. Ads Manager showed ROAS up to 13×, and EasyOrders showed EGP 6.74M in sales for June 2026. After cancellations and returns, the real ROAS stayed under 4×.

  2. What I found

    A tracking problem, and a website that wasn't sending enough data back to Meta. The ads were optimizing for orders that never got confirmed.

  3. What I changed

    Moved the store to Shopify in July 2026 to fix tracking and see real customer behavior, then rebuilt and scaled the campaigns from there.

Before: what the dashboards said vs. what was real

I analyzed the EasyOrders results week by week, comparing the orders Meta reported with the orders that were actually confirmed. After that analysis, we moved the store to Shopify.

After: on Shopify
